evidence_snippets: Use Triage and Investigation Agent to investigate alerts Supported in: Google secops The Triage and Investigation Agent (TIN) is an AI-powered investigation assistant embedded in Google Security Operations.
It determines if the alerts are true or false positives, then provides a summarized explanation for its assessment.
